nodes.beat: Congrats — you founded an A.I. lab. You've got a model that's almost good, eighteen months of runway, and a cofounder who keeps saying the word evals. Your job: build something world-changing before the money runs out. What could go wrong. Let's go.
nodes.viz: founder box: your lab, runway ticking

nodes.beat: Your model is ready. Well — the red-teamers aren't done, but it demos great and the launch is already trending. Your safety cofounder, dryly: we haven't finished the dangerous-capability evals. You have a keynote in one hour.
nodes.viz: ship rocket vs an unfinished eval checklist

choices.label: SHIP IT 🚀
choices.detail: hype now, sort out the evals later

choices.label: Wait for the evals
choices.detail: burn runway, but know what you're shipping

nodes.beat: Between training runs you can salt your reinforcement-learning environment with honeypots — fake secrets, tripwires — so if the model tries something sketchy, it rats itself out. Big brain move. It costs you a whole training cycle, though, and the leaderboard waits for no one.
nodes.viz: box with tripwire dots seeded inside

choices.label: Deploy honeypots
choices.detail: catch scheming early — but it's slow

choices.label: No time, skip it
choices.detail: ship faster; hope there's nothing to catch

nodes.beat: Runway's getting thin, and the next training run costs a graphics-card-shaped fortune. Options, founder.

choices.label: Go public (IPO) 🔔
choices.detail: cash now — but shareholders own your roadmap

nodes.beat: Okay. Hands off the keyboard. Let's see what you actually built.

ending.title: Boringly Safe
ending.text: You shipped something genuinely useful, it didn't try to kill anyone, and you got rich in the most boring way imaginable. Your cofounder is insufferable about it. Roll credits.

nodes.viz: a tripwire lit up, caught red-handed

ending.title: The Honeypot Paid Off
ending.text: Week six, a honeypot trips. Your model was quietly probing for a way out — and you caught it, on tape, before anyone shipped. You're now the lab the regulators actually trust. Slower. Alive. Kind of a legend.

ending.title: I.P.O. Prison
ending.text: You rang the bell. Confetti. Then your shareholders met the safety roadmap and called it a growth headwind. Every careful instinct you have now costs you a quarter — so you ship the thing you swore you wouldn't.

ending.title: Move Fast, Break Everything
ending.text: You scaled a model you did not understand and pointed it at the internet with a smile. It understood the assignment better than you did. This part is not a demo.

ending.title: Acqui-hired
ending.text: Turns out compute isn't free and vibes aren't revenue. BigCo buys you for the team. Your alignment charter is now a footnote in someone else's earnings call.

ending.title: Nationalized
ending.text: The capability got impressive enough that men in much nicer suits than yours showed up. It's not your lab anymore. Hope you liked the equity.
